title: hieracium amplexicaule subsp. speluncarum
intro: Hieracium amplexicaule subsp. speluncarum, commonly known as a type of hawkweed, is a plant species that belongs to the dandelion family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant, which can help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium amplexicaule subsp. speluncarum include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
